prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1442; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim file for that.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Houston, driving slowly down one of the aisles looking for an open space.

Q: Had you been there long before the collision?

A: No, I'd just pulled in a minute or two before. I was going maybe five miles an hour.

Q: Can you describe the other vehicle?

A: It was a pickup truck. It backed out of a space on my left without me seeing it. I hit my brakes, but I still got clipped on the front quarter panel.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: Not right away. I felt fine for maybe an hour. Then my neck started to stiffen up and the pain went down into my shoulders.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same evening and they diagnosed whiplash. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you currently missing work because of the injury?

A: I've been limited. I can sit at a desk, but I can't drive for long stretches, so I've had to rearrange some of my schedule.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that the other driver seemed apologetic at the scene, and I want the claim handled fairly for everyone involved.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
